ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 9:1 ratio of low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multiple discrete high-intensity white speckles scattered across both lobes; two larger contiguous white amorphous blobs located in the superior-medial region of the right lobe near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; central depression angle estimated at 45-50 degrees relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) varying between 5-15 pixels in depth along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curves extending from the median notch vertex toward the lateral tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters, ranging from 2 to 10 pixels in diameter, concentrated primarily on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal white linear disruption visible on the medial-center of the left lobe; multiple smaller unaligned white streaks on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and micro-tears along the trailing edge topography, consistent with previous biofouling or physical interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density cluster of white point-like speckles localized in the posterior-medial quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
